title: Remove zero-cursor and single-batch assumptions from remaining relay boot test callers
outcome: The sibling boot-pages fixture and remaining callers that require all home wakes delivered do not mistake an initial zero-row batch returning (0,0) for a complete drain. Preserve production budgets and scheduling, and test durable outcomes with deterministic partial/zero-row controls.
acceptance: Remove zero-cursor and single-batch assumptions from remaining relay boot test callers is done
